item.title: BOYS BASKETBALL: Rose, Parker reach 1,000 career points
item.description: Brayden Rose scored 37 points, including the 1,000th of his career, and had 10 rebounds to lead No. 1 Riverside to an 87-35 victory over Honesdale in a Lackawanna League Division II boys basketball game Monday at Riverside. The Riverside junior entered the game needing 34 points to reach the milestone. He hit 12 shots, including three 3-pointers, and went 10 for 10 from the free throw line. item.title: ATHLETE OF THE WEEK: Addison Kilmer, Mountain View basketball
item.description: The Mountain View senior scored 38 points, including the 2,000th of her career, in a 61-29 win over Susquehanna. She needed 27 to reach the milestone going into the game, and had 24 in the first half. She reached the mark on a 3-pointer in the third quarter, becoming the 11th player in Lackawanna League history with 2,000 career points. Kilmer also had 31 points in a 63-44 win over Lackawanna Trail to push her career total to 2,042 points. Family: Ashley, mother; Matthew, father; Bronson, brothe

item.title: GIRLS BASKETBALL: Lackawanna League division races head down the stretch
item.description: It is hard to believe that February is here and there are just two weeks left in the Lackawanna League girls basketball regular season. That means the division races are heading down the stretch and teams are looking to secure the best possible seed for the District 2 playoffs. This week could go a long way to determining both. item.title: PIAA WRESTLING: Abington Heights, Honesdale set for openers
item.description: For the first time in four years, Abington Heights captured a District 2 Class 3A wrestling duals title. Meanwhile, Honesdale stayed atop District 2 Class 2A for the fourth straight season. Now, the District 2 squads will host their PIAA first-round matches Tuesday, with the Comets wrestling at Scranton High School because of the Pink Night girls basketball game at Abington Heights, and the Hornets getting another home match. item.title: LOCAL OLYMPICS CONNECTIONS: Knapp calling curling competition again

item.title: HS ROUNDUP: Scranton’s Jacklinski scores 1,000th point
item.description: Chrissy Jacklinski scored 27 points, including the 1,000th of her career, to lead No. 6 Scranton to a 61-26 victory over West Scranton on Monday night at Lackawanna College Student Union. Jacklinski had 973 points entering the game, and reached the milestone in the third quarter. Jaelyn Alers added 13 points for the Lady Knights (8-11, 5-6), while Jahiya Parker added seven points.
